idea-plugin.name: Worktree Lifecycle MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Let your MCP client manage independent IntelliJ Platform projects by directory, without attaching them to another project or opening duplicate windows.

  • Inspect open projects and their window state.
  • Open or reuse a project; close an exact project with normal IDE safeguards.
  • Optionally merge all eligible macOS project windows into native tabs.
  • Find IDE actions by name or ID, inspect availability, and run an exact action.

Requires the bundled MCP Server and a connected MCP client. Supports IntelliJ Platform builds 262.10968.77 through 262.*. Actions use project/window context or an explicitly requested, already-open text editor in that project. macOS fullscreen and Spaces merging is best-effort.

Documentation · Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — First stable release of project lifecycle and context-aware IDE action tools.

0.5.1 — Allow IntelliJ Platform 262 patch updates while retaining the minimum supported build. Use platform-supported explicit action contexts for injected-language handling.

0.5.0 — Shared action availability reasons for search and dispatch, including modal preflight.

0.4.0 — Optional explicit file/editor context for action search and dispatch without selecting tabs.

0.3.0 — New plugin logo and expanded plugin description.

0.2.0 — Search IDE actions by name or ID with project-scoped availability.

0.1.0 — Exact-directory project open, reuse, close, window merge, and action execution.
